key.name: desktop-theme
key.summary: Keep the desktop's shell theme on the lock screen
key.description: GNOME switches the User Themes extension off while the screen is locked. With this on, the theme it shows on the desktop is loaded again for the lock screen.

key.name: change-wallpaper
key.summary: Change how the wallpaper shows on the lock screen
key.description: With this off, the wallpaper stays blurred and dark, as GNOME shows it.

key.name: wallpaper-blur
key.description: 0 shows the picture sharp. GNOME's own value is 45 (60 before GNOME 44).

key.name: wallpaper-brightness
key.summary: Brightness of the wallpaper, in percent
key.description: 100 shows the picture as it is. GNOME's own value is 65 (55 before GNOME 44).

key.name: date-above-time
key.summary: Show the date above the time

key.name: hide-am-pm
key.summary: Show only the digits of the time
key.description: Removes AM and PM from a 12-hour clock.

key.name: clock-top
key.summary: Distance of the clock from the top, in percent of the screen's height

key.name: style-clock
key.summary: Write the clock in bold white letters with a soft shadow

key.name: time-size
key.summary: Size of the time, in points

key.name: date-size
key.summary: Size of the date, in points

key.name: clock-font
key.description: Empty uses the font the desktop is set to use.
